cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Could you cancel our anniversary table? The restaurant number's on the fridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call. They might ask whether you want another date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say no for me. Then stay while I put the anniversary glasses away. You can tell me about your day.

mechanism: A assigns a formerly coached pupil a familiar phone task, then relies on that pupil to carry an emotionally final answer it cannot comfortably say.
confusable: Not merely delegation: the anniversary objects and avoidance of explanation make the burden emotional; familiar corrections conceal A reliance.
comparison: Practical cancellation and companionship versus shared reading pace.
seedUse: D97 anniversary cancellation/glasses; S05 familiar telephone coaching becomes support request.
